title: "The Biology of the Flying Saucer—III", The Aeroplane, 19 Mar 1948 (Figs. 19-20)
description: Magazine page from The Aeroplane (March 19, 1948, p. 337) with part III of A. R. Weyl's series. A photograph is captioned "Fig. 19.—An American 'Flying Flapjack' with two engines. It crashed while under test (1938)." Fig. 20 consists of two plots of lift coefficient against drag coefficient for wings of different aspect ratio, from 1920 Goettingen wind-tunnel results, including a square wing.
